arduino_mega.agent_notes: Open the USB and DC-jack end to the outside; mount it on standoffs through its holes; leave room above the headers for wires.
arduino_mega.description: Large Arduino board (ATmega2560) with many pins.

arduino_nano.agent_notes: Leave the USB Mini-B socket reachable through a wall opening, and room above the pin rows for wires or a socket.
arduino_nano.description: Small microcontroller board (ATmega328P) with a USB Mini-B socket.

electrical.connectors: USB Mini-B; 2 rows of 2.54 mm pins

arduino_uno_compatible.agent_notes: Open the USB and DC-jack end of the board to the outside. Mount it on standoffs through its holes; leave room above the headers for shields or wires.
arduino_uno_compatible.description: Arduino Uno-compatible board (Freaduino), the Uno's size and mounting holes.

audio_jack_3_5mm.agent_notes: Its mouth at a wall with a round opening.

battery_aa.agent_notes: Hold it in a holder or a clip; leave a door to change it.

battery_aaa.agent_notes: Hold it in a holder or a clip; leave a door to change it.

battery_holder_4aaa.agent_notes: Put it behind a battery door the user can open; leave a path for its two wires.

battery_holder_8aaa.agent_notes: Put it behind a battery door the user can open.

blower_50mm.agent_notes: Leave its face inlet open and duct its side outlet to a vent.
blower_50mm.description: 50 mm radial (blower) fan: air in at the face, out at the side.

buzzer.agent_notes: Sound must get out: a hole or a few small holes over its opening.

cherry_mx_switch.agent_notes: It clips into a 14 mm square plate hole in a 1.5 mm plate; a key cap goes on its stem.

cqrobot_37d.agent_notes: Mount it by the screws in its gearbox face; leave room behind the encoder for its cable.
cqrobot_37d.description: 37 mm metal gearmotor with an encoder.

dc_jack_2_1mm.agent_notes: Its mouth must sit at a wall with a round opening and room outside for the plug.
dc_jack_2_1mm.description: Power socket for a 2.1 mm barrel plug.

dc_motor_encoder.agent_notes: Mount it by its face; leave room behind it for the encoder.
dc_motor_encoder.description: Small DC motor with an encoder disc on the back.

dhb12_driver.agent_notes: Leave its terminals reachable and air over it.

emax_es08a.agent_notes: Hold it by its mounting ears in a pocket the body's size; the horn needs room to swing.

emergency_stop_22mm.agent_notes: Put it where a hand finds it at once, on top or the front, nothing round it to catch; 22 mm panel hole.
emergency_stop_22mm.description: Red mushroom-head emergency-stop button for a 22 mm hole.
emergency_stop_22mm.path: Electrical Parts/Push buttons/Emergency stop mushroom head push-button - 22 mm.step

endstop_makerbot.agent_notes: Mount it by its holes where the moving part presses the lever.
endstop_makerbot.description: Microswitch endstop on a small board, as on 3D printers.

esp32_devkit.agent_notes: Keep the antenna end of the module clear of metal and of thick walls near it (no metal in front of it); leave the Micro-USB socket reachable.
esp32_devkit.description: ESP32 Wi-Fi/Bluetooth development board with a Micro-USB socket.

electrical.wiring: ESP32 with Wi-Fi and Bluetooth; 3.3 V logic

fan_40mm.agent_notes: Air must reach both faces: a grille in the wall over it (not a solid wall) and an inlet elsewhere so air flows through. Mount by its corner holes.

fan_50mm.agent_notes: A grille over it and an inlet elsewhere; mount by its corner holes.

faulhaber_2342.agent_notes: Mount it by the screws in its face; keep its shaft aligned with what it drives.

futaba_s3003.agent_notes: Hold it by its four mounting ears; the horn needs room to swing.

gnss_antenna.agent_notes: It needs a view of the sky: top of the product, under plastic only, never under metal.

hc_sr04.agent_notes: Both transducers must look out through the wall: one round hole each, a little wider than the transducer, with nothing in front of them. Point them at what is measured.
hc_sr04.description: Ultrasonic distance sensor with two round transducers.

hdmi_jack.agent_notes: Its mouth at a wall with an opening that clears the plug's overmould.

heatsink_19mm.agent_notes: Air must pass through its fins: vents in line with them.

inductive_proximity.agent_notes: Mount it by its thread through a wall or bracket hole with its two nuts; its face must be free, no metal round the face.
inductive_proximity.description: Threaded cylindrical sensor that detects metal at its face.

irm60_psu.agent_notes: MAINS VOLTAGE: only for a design whose maker knows mains safety. Fully enclosed, no openings a finger or tool can reach live parts through, a proper strain-relieved mains inlet, and the low-voltage side kept apart.
irm60_psu.path: Electrical Parts/Power Supplies/IRM-60 ST series power supply/IRM-60 ST power supply.step

l298n_driver.agent_notes: Its heatsink gets hot: vents over it and no wall touching it. Leave its screw terminals reachable.
l298n_driver.description: Dual H-bridge motor driver board with a heatsink.

electrical.wiring: dual H-bridge: two DC motors or one stepper

lcd_20x4.agent_notes: A window the size of its viewing area in the front; mount the board by its four corner holes behind the wall.
lcd_20x4.description: Character LCD module, four lines of 20.

led_3mm.agent_notes: Through a 3 mm hole, or behind a light pipe.

led_5mm.agent_notes: Its dome can poke through a 5 mm hole, or sit behind a light pipe or a thin diffuser.

led_bargraph.agent_notes: A window over its face; nothing in front of the segments.

lipo_240mah.agent_notes: Give it a pocket with a little room to swell, nothing sharp against it, away from hot parts; never clamp it.

lm2596_buck.agent_notes: Leave its trim potentiometer reachable (or set it before closing) and air over its inductor and chip.

maxsonar_mb1010.agent_notes: The transducer must look out through a round hole with nothing in front of it.
maxsonar_mb1010.description: Ultrasonic range finder with one transducer.

electrical.wiring: 2.5-5.5 V; analog, serial or pulse-width output

micro_sd_card.agent_notes: A slot in the wall in line with the card socket, with room for a fingertip to push it in and out.
micro_sd_card.description: A micro-SD card (the card, for a slot).

microswitch_lever.agent_notes: Mount it by its two holes where the moving part presses the lever; leave over-travel.
microswitch_lever.description: Snap-action limit switch with a lever.

mini_vacuum_pump.agent_notes: Leave its two nozzles reachable for tubing; it vibrates: mount it on soft pads, not hard against the case.

nema17_bracket.description: L bracket for a NEMA 17 motor.

nema17_stepper_fc.agent_notes: Mount it by the four screws in its face; leave the connector reachable and air round the body (it runs warm).
nema17_stepper_fc.description: Standard 42 mm stepper motor with its cable connector.

photoresistor.agent_notes: It reads the light that reaches it: an opening or a clear window over its face.

pololu_micro_298.agent_notes: Clamp the gearbox in a bracket or a pocket with a strap; the motor end needs its two terminals reachable.

potentiometer.agent_notes: Its bushing mounts through a panel hole with its nut; a knob goes on the shaft outside.

push_button_22mm_green.agent_notes: It mounts through a 22 mm panel hole; its contact block needs room behind the wall.
push_button_22mm_green.description: Industrial panel push button for a 22 mm hole.

push_button_22mm_red.agent_notes: It mounts through a 22 mm panel hole (about 22.3 mm) in a wall no thicker than its thread allows; its contact block hangs behind the wall and needs room.
push_button_22mm_red.description: Industrial panel push button for a 22 mm hole.

raspberry_pi_4b.agent_notes: Open the connector edges you need (USB/Ethernet end, USB-C and HDMI side) to the outside; it runs warm: vent the case or leave room for a heatsink or fan over the processor. Mount on M2.5 standoffs through its four holes.
raspberry_pi_4b.description: Single-board computer with USB-C power, two micro-HDMI, four USB-A and Ethernet.

electrical.connectors: USB-C power, 2 micro-HDMI, 4 USB-A, Ethernet, 3.5 mm jack

raspberry_pi_pico.agent_notes: Leave the Micro-USB socket reachable and room for pins or wires along both long edges.
raspberry_pi_pico.description: Small RP2040 microcontroller board with a Micro-USB socket.

raspi_camera_wide.agent_notes: Its view is very wide: the lens opening must be wide and short (countersunk, wider outside) or the case shows in the picture. Leave a path for the flat ribbon cable.
raspi_camera_wide.description: Camera board with a 170° wide-angle lens for the Raspberry Pi.

rgb_led_5mm.agent_notes: Behind a diffuser the colours mix; through a hole they show apart.

rj45_jack.agent_notes: Its mouth at a wall with room for the plug's latch to be pressed.

rocker_switch_round.agent_notes: It snaps into a round panel hole the size of its body; leave room behind for its two terminals.

rotary_encoder.agent_notes: Its threaded bushing mounts through a panel hole with its nut; a knob goes on the shaft outside.
rotary_encoder.description: Rotary encoder knob shaft with a push switch.

seven_segment.agent_notes: A window or a tinted panel over its face.

sg90_servo.agent_notes: Hold it by its mounting ears (two screws) in a pocket the body's size; its output shaft and horn need room to swing; leave a path for the 3-wire lead.
sg90_servo.description: Micro hobby servo, about 180° of travel.

sharp_gp2y0a02.agent_notes: The two lenses (emitter and receiver) must see out: an opening over both, or an IR-clear window.
sharp_gp2y0a02.description: Infrared distance sensor, 20 to 150 cm, analog output.
sharp_gp2y0a02.display_name: Sharp GP2Y0A02YK0F IR distance sensor (20-150 cm)

sharp_gp2y0a41.agent_notes: The two lenses (emitter and receiver) must see out: an opening over both, or an IR-clear window; never cover them with ordinary plastic.
sharp_gp2y0a41.description: Infrared distance sensor, 4 to 30 cm, analog output.
sharp_gp2y0a41.display_name: Sharp GP2Y0A41SK0F IR distance sensor (4-30 cm)

slide_switch.agent_notes: Its lever needs a slot in the wall a little longer than its travel.

springrc_sm_s4303r.agent_notes: Hold it by its four mounting ears; it can drive a wheel directly on its horn.
springrc_sm_s4303r.description: Standard-size servo that turns continuously (a geared motor driven by a servo signal).

electrical.wiring: PWM signal sets speed and direction

stepper_28byj48.agent_notes: Mount it by its two ears; the shaft is off-centre. Leave a path for the 5-wire lead to its driver board.

switching_psu.agent_notes: MAINS VOLTAGE: cover its terminal block, keep its vents open, and use a proper mains inlet with strain relief.
switching_psu.description: Enclosed mains-to-DC power supply with screw terminals.
switching_psu.path: Electrical Parts/Power Supplies/Switching power supply/Switching power supply.step

tactile_button.agent_notes: Bring a plunger or a flexible button in the case down onto it; leave a little travel.

tactile_button_right_angle.agent_notes: Its plunger faces sideways: put it at a wall with a button or opening in front.
tactile_button_right_angle.description: Side-pressed tactile switch for a board edge.

terminal_block_2.agent_notes: Its screws must be reachable with a screwdriver and its wire entries face an opening or the open case.

terminal_block_4.agent_notes: Its screws reachable, its wire entries facing an opening.

tft_2_4in.agent_notes: A window over the screen area only; mount the board by its holes behind the wall.
tft_2_4in.description: Colour TFT display on a carrier board.

tft_3_5in_rpi.agent_notes: A window over the screen; it sits on the Pi's header, so design the two together.
tft_3_5in_rpi.description: Colour TFT display that plugs onto a Raspberry Pi's header.
tft_3_5in_rpi.display_name: TFT display, 3.5 in, 480 × 320, for Raspberry Pi (SPI)

toggle_switch_1p2t.agent_notes: Mount it through a panel hole by its threaded bushing and nut.
toggle_switch_1p2t.path: Electronics Parts/Switch/Mini toggle switch 1P2T/Interuptor conmutador 1P2T PCB.step

tt_gearmotor.agent_notes: Hold it by its two through-holes; a TT wheel fits its shaft. Leave a path for its two wires.
tt_gearmotor.description: The common yellow hobby gear motor, double output shaft.

tt_gearmotor_l.agent_notes: Hold it by its through-holes; a TT wheel fits its shaft.
tt_gearmotor_l.description: The common yellow hobby gear motor, motor at right angles to the shaft.

tt_wheel_65mm.agent_notes: Give it clearance all round inside any wheel arch; it sits on the TT motor's shaft.
tt_wheel_65mm.description: 65 mm rubber-tyred wheel that fits the TT gear motor.
tt_wheel_65mm.display_name: Wheel for TT gear motor, 65 mm

usb_a_dual.agent_notes: Its mouths at a wall with an opening round both.

usb_b_jack.agent_notes: Its mouth at a wall with an opening a little larger than the plug, and room outside for the plug.

usb_micro_b.agent_notes: Its mouth at a wall; the opening must clear the plug's overmould, not only its metal.
